description: Automatic levee-detection inputs cover six Japanese cities: Chiba, Kawasaki, Kitakyushu, Nagano, Okayama and Okazaki. The deposit lists elevation rasters, labelled levees, river and road lines, cross-validation regions and derived features. This resource is provided by Annonymous. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists GZ formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The training labels and selected urban areas constrain generalization to other levee forms. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
